announcements.title: Microsoft Excel Training – New Batch
announcements.body: Intermediate to advanced online Excel training starts in October, with classes every day at 6:00 PM. Fee: ₹200. Basic Excel knowledge required. View the course page for details in English and Hindi and the registration form.

announcements.title: Mentorship Programme
announcements.body: Open now — students, professionals, and parents can get guidance from experienced mentors and subject experts. Fill in the form on the programme page to request mentorship.
